Ivy: quick alert 08:42 UTC 5 - noticed a cascade after yesterday's dedupe ruleset change: a lot of low-touch accounts lost activity anchors and pinged the renewal workflow.
Ravi: saw the spike. renewal queue up ~14% for micro accounts. timeline lines up with dedupe deploy at 07:30.
Jules: that ruleset tightened matching and collapsed several contact rows; we added 'null_owner -> unassigned' semantics which probably triggered playbook reassign.
Ivy: can we get a small sample? SQL to find accounts that had last_touch before and null after:
```
SELECT account_id, last_touch_before, last_touch_after, owner_before, owner_after
FROM cs_ops.dedupe_impact
WHERE change_ts BETWEEN '2026-04-22 07:20' AND '2026-04-22 07:50'
LIMIT 200;
```
Ravi: running it now. initial sample: ~11% of micro cohort had last_touch nullified, ~6% crossed stale threshold and hit renewal playbooks.
Jules: hotfix idea: treat merged.contact_last_touch as precedence over merged.owner_null and keep previous anchor if last_touch exists. simpler: add a support label 'dedupe-preserve-anchor' for merges that drop timestamps.
Ivy: propose immediate steps: 1) pause auto-renewal-trigger in playbook-runner for micro cohort, 2) push dedupe patch that preserves timestamp anchors, 3) backfill affected accounts from pre-merge snapshot. agree?
Ravi: +1. I'll pause the playbook trigger and mark affected cohort in the runbook.
ops-bot: :information_source: Deploy 2026-04-22T07:30Z: contact-dedupe-service v2.9.3 by Jules. Pause requested for playbook-runner (micro cohort).
Jules: patch ready, switching merge behavior to fallback_on(previous.last_touch) and emit audit tag merge_preserve_ts. will stage and dry-run for 10m.
Ivy: also add an alert rule: if >3% cohort shift to 'renewal_high' within 1h after any dedupe deploy, auto-pause outbound campaigns.
cs-bot: :information_source: Playbook-runner pause applied for cohort=micro by Ravi at 07:58 UTC.
Ravi: I'll kick off backfill job using snapshot_20260422_0720 and re-evaluate thresholds before resuming outreach. ETA ~1.5h.
Jules: once dry-run looks good I'll unpause and we can run a reconciliation that prefers preserved anchors.
Ivy: thanks. let's keep CS ops in the loop and send a short note to account owners for any high-value accounts impacted. :thumbsup:
